<!--
Want a language that isn't on the list of ten? Open this issue so I
can prioritise. Bonus points if you're willing to seed the
translation yourself.
-->

### Which language?

- Language name (in its own language, e.g. "Nederlands"): _____
- ISO locale code (e.g. `nl_NL`, `tr_TR`, `ar_SA`, `hi_IN`): `xx_XX`

### Why this language?

A few words on why this locale matters — for example:
- Active local SD community
- Personal use
- Underserved by other localisation tools
- etc.

### Are you offering to translate?

- [ ] Yes, I can seed the full ~960-key translation myself.
- [ ] Yes, partially — I can translate the most important keys.
- [ ] No, but I'd be happy to review someone else's translation.
- [ ] Just suggesting; can't translate.

### Anything else?

Notes about the language's conventions, SD-community jargon, or
similar that would help whoever produces the seed translation.

Thank you 🙏
